note: Parent token deltas are measured uncached parent input plus parent output, B minus A, on matched pairs. Positive means delegation used MORE parent work. These are repeated runs of a small fixed set of tasks, not task-population estimates.

worker_quality.summary: raw output had literal escaped newlines; parent repair required
worker_quality.gate: exhausted 2048-token output budget; native fallback required

cohorts.decision: PARENT_ONLY; capability evidence recorded with eligible=false
cohorts.reason: Worker correctness alone did not justify delegation: parent input, latency and repair/fallback burden all increased, and no defensible positive delegation threshold was established.

cohorts.task_repeats: 30 repeats each of two public implementation tasks; not 60 independent task families
cohorts.grading_note: The original grader rejected two B-arm gate outputs for using numeric as_integer_ratio. grading-v2 preserves that correction separately; no inference was rerun.
cohorts.cache_controlled_note: The raw aggregate is confounded by unequal cache hits. Removing the cache imbalance algebraically still leaves +45140 parent input/output tokens. That is a sensitivity analysis, not a measured uncached saving.

worker_latency.note: Timing is noisy and is not an independent causal cost estimate.

cohorts.reason: Clean, fast execution did not reduce measured parent work at these task sizes. Both tasks increased parent work in the equal-cache subset.

excluded_cohort.why: All four worker calls exhausted the 2048-token completion budget with empty final output. Preserved as configuration failures and explicitly NOT pooled as code-quality evidence.

hypothesis.text: Delegation cannot save parent tokens when the parent still consumes the original task plus a verbose worker response. On these task sizes the worker response is a net addition to parent context rather than a replacement for parent work.
hypothesis.next_experiment: Typed or compressed worker artifacts, not simply a better worker model.

unmeasured: A task size or mix where delegation reduces parent work
Whether typed/compressed worker artifacts change the direction of the effect
Dollar savings of any kind (billing is trial_or_existing_credit_unverified in both cohorts)
